details.id: T-41 gear train ratio is the exact rational product of tooth ratios
T-41 output angle equals the exact ratio times the input to within two roundings (2^-52 relative)
T-41 differential carrier is the mean of its inputs within 1e-12
T-42 lone integrator gives t^2/2 (RK4 is exact for it up to rounding)

T-42 exponential-decay.analyser.yaml Dormand-Prince rtol 1e-10: relative error with floor 1e-9 <= 1e-7
T-42 harmonic-oscillator.analyser.yaml RK4 h=0.01: max abs error over amplitude <= 1e-4
T-42 harmonic-oscillator.analyser.yaml Dormand-Prince rtol 1e-10: relative error with floor 1e-9 <= 1e-7
